name: Superbet
verdict: Gambling group founded and led by Sacha Dragic, with a Blackstone minority stake. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: front-of-shirt sponsor of Olympiacos BC from 2026 to 2032 (Sport24, 3 July 2026). Superbet Group was founded in 2008 by its CEO Sacha Dragic; funds managed by Blackstone's Tactical Opportunities business hold a strategic minority stake (Blackstone, May 2019; Simpson Thacher, February 2025). No state or state fund in the chain, and no sourced human-rights finding against Superbet or Blackstone that passes METHOD.md was found (checked 2026-10-01).
